amritvela.title: 🌙 Waheguru Ji...
amritvela.body: Amritvela bakhshish da sama hai. Aao Naam naal din di shuruaat kariye. 🙏
amritvela.translation: Waheguru Ji... It's the blessed time of Amritvela. Come, let's start the day with Naam.

amritvela.title: ✨ Raat da andhera hatda ja reha hai
amritvela.body: Amritvela vich Guru Maharaj Ji nazdeek mehsoos hunde ne. 🌸
amritvela.translation: The darkness of night is fading. Guru Maharaj Ji feels closer during Amritvela.

amritvela.title: 🪷 Sab soye hoi ne...
amritvela.body: Par tusi Guru de charna vich baithne da sama paa sakte ho. 🙏
amritvela.translation: Everyone is asleep... But you can find time to sit at Guru's feet.

amritvela.title: 🌺 Subah da pehla vela
amritvela.body: Guru Sahib nu yaad karan da vela hai. Mann shant ho jayega. 🤍
amritvela.translation: The first hour of morning. It's time to remember Guru Sahib. Your mind will find peace.

amritvela.title: ☀️ Suraj niklan ton pehle
amritvela.body: Naam Simran di roshni mann vich paida kariye. 🌸
amritvela.translation: Before sunrise. Create the light of Naam Simran within your mind.

amritvela.title: 🌙 Guru Ji bula rahe ne
amritvela.body: Amritvela vich Naam jap ke din nu bakhshish banao. 🙏
amritvela.translation: Guru Ji is calling. Chant Naam in Amritvela and make the day blessed.

amritvela.title: ✨ Anmol vela aa gaya
amritvela.body: Kujh pal Waheguru de Naam vich bitao. Ruh shant ho jayegi. 🪷
amritvela.translation: The precious time has arrived. Spend a few moments in Waheguru's Naam. Your soul will find peace.

amritvela.title: 🌸 Neend ton jagna hi kaafi nahi
amritvela.body: Ruh nu vi jagao Naam naal. Amritvela da vela hai. 🙏
amritvela.translation: Waking from sleep isn't enough. Awaken your soul with Naam. It's Amritvela time.

amritvela.title: 🤍 Guru Kirpa naal uthna ho gaya
amritvela.body: Hun kujh pal Naam Simran vich bithao. 🌺
amritvela.translation: By Guru's grace, you've awakened. Now spend a few moments in Naam Simran.

amritvela.title: 🕊️ Hor sab intezaar kar sakda
amritvela.body: Pehle Guru Maharaj Ji naal kujh pal bitao. 🌸
amritvela.translation: Everything else can wait. First spend a few moments with Guru Maharaj Ji.

amritvela.title: 🌙 Amritvela di mithaas
amritvela.body: Eh vela Guru de darshan da vela hai. Aao nazdeek aiye. 🙏
amritvela.translation: The sweetness of Amritvela. This time is for Guru's darshan. Come closer.

amritvela.title: ✨ Andhera khatam hunda vekh rahe ho?
amritvela.body: Mann da andhera vi Naam naal khatam ho sakda. 🪷
amritvela.translation: Watching the darkness end? The darkness of mind can also end with Naam.

amritvela.title: 🌸 Duniya nu shanti chahiye
amritvela.body: Par pehle apne mann nu Naam naal shant karo. Amritvela hai. 🙏
amritvela.translation: The world needs peace. But first, calm your own mind with Naam. It's Amritvela.

amritvela.title: 🌺 Har din di ik navin shuruaat
amritvela.body: Guru de Naam naal kariye. Amritvela bakhshish hai. 🤍
amritvela.translation: A fresh start to each day. Begin with Guru's Naam. Amritvela is a blessing.

amritvela.title: ☀️ Roshni aun wali hai
amritvela.body: Par Naam di roshni hamesha naal hai. Kujh pal jap laiyo. 🙏
amritvela.translation: Light is coming. But the light of Naam is always with you. Chant for a few moments.

amritvela.title: 🪷 Shant raato baad
amritvela.body: Amritvela vich Guru Sahib naal mann di gal karo. 🌸
amritvela.translation: After a peaceful night. In Amritvela, speak to Guru Sahib from the heart.

amritvela.title: 🌙 Guru Ji yaad kar rahe ne
amritvela.body: Amritvela da eh anmol vela waste hi hai. Aao baithiye. 🙏
amritvela.translation: Guru Ji is remembering you. This precious time of Amritvela is just for this. Come, sit.

amritvela.title: ✨ Chup-chaap, shaant vela
amritvela.body: Sirf tusi te Waheguru. Kujh pal Naam Simran kariye. 🤍
amritvela.translation: Silent, peaceful time. Just you and Waheguru. Do Naam Simran for a few moments.

amritvela.title: 🌸 Ajj di pehli yaad
amritvela.body: Waheguru di honi chahidi. Amritvela bakhshish vela hai. 🙏
amritvela.translation: Today's first thought. Should be of Waheguru. Amritvela is blessed time.

amritvela.title: 🌺 Guru Ghar di mehak
amritvela.body: Amritvela vich sabto zyada mehsoos hondi hai. 🙏
amritvela.translation: The fragrance of Guru's house. Feels strongest in Amritvela.

amritvela.title: 🕊️ Mann vich hulchul hai?
amritvela.body: Amritvela vich Naam jap ke sukoon pao. 🌸
amritvela.translation: Is your mind restless? Chant Naam in Amritvela and find peace.

amritvela.title: 🤍 Raat gayi, nava din aaya
amritvela.body: Guru Maharaj Ji de charna ton shuruaat karo. 🙏
amritvela.translation: Night passed, new day arrived. Start from Guru Maharaj Ji's feet.

amritvela.title: 🌙 Chanani nu alvida karo
amritvela.body: Naam di roshni naal din da swagat karo. Amritvela hai. 🌸
amritvela.translation: Say goodbye to moonlight. Welcome the day with the light of Naam. It's Amritvela.

amritvela.title: ✨ Subah da jadoo shuru ho gaya
amritvela.body: Naam Simran naal mann vich vi jadoo bhar do. 🪷
amritvela.translation: Morning's magic has begun. Fill your mind with magic through Naam Simran too.

amritvela.title: 🌸 Parmatma nazdeek hai
amritvela.body: Amritvela vich Waheguru da darshan aasan hai. 🙏
amritvela.translation: God is near. In Amritvela, Waheguru's vision is easier.

amritvela.title: 🌺 Koi jagda nahi, koi shor nahi
amritvela.body: Sirf Guru de Naam di awaaz. Amritvela da vela hai. 🤍
amritvela.translation: No one awake, no noise. Only the sound of Guru's Naam. It's Amritvela time.

japji_sahib.title: 📖 Waheguru Ji...
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath da sama aa gaya hai. Guru Kirpa prapat kariye. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Waheguru Ji... Time for Japji Sahib has arrived. Receive Guru's grace.

japji_sahib.title: 🌸 Din di shuruaat Guru Nanak Ji naal
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath karke mann nu shanti bakhsho. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Start the day with Guru Nanak Ji. Give peace to your mind by reading Japji Sahib.

japji_sahib.title: ✨ 38 paurian, asankh bakhshishan
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib da vela hai. Aao Guru Ghar vich aiye. 🌺
japji_sahib.translation: 38 pauris, countless blessings. It's time for Japji Sahib. Come to Guru's house.

japji_sahib.title: 🪷 Sachcha Naam, sachchi bani
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath da anmol vela aa gaya hai. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: True Naam, true word. The precious time for Japji Sahib has arrived.

japji_sahib.title: 🤍 Guru Nanak Ji bulare ne
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib naal din di roshni shuru kariye. 🌸
japji_sahib.translation: Guru Nanak Ji is calling. Start the day's light with Japji Sahib.

japji_sahib.title: 📖 Mann nu tayyar karo
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib de darshan da vela aa gaya. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Prepare your mind. Time for Japji Sahib's vision has come.

japji_sahib.title: 🌺 Ik Onkar satnam
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib naal shuru karo ajj da safar. 🌸
japji_sahib.translation: Ik Onkar Satnam. Start today's journey with Japji Sahib.

japji_sahib.title: ✨ Pehla paath, pehli bakhshish
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath da sama hai. Aao shanti pao. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: First prayer, first blessing. It's time for Japji Sahib. Come find peace.

japji_sahib.title: 🌸 Guru Granth Sahib Ji di pehli bani
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath karan da vela hai. Mann lagao. 🪷
japji_sahib.translation: The first bani of Guru Granth Sahib. Time to read Japji Sahib. Focus your mind.

japji_sahib.title: 🙏 Nitnem di neev
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib naal rakho. Aao paath kariye. 🌺
japji_sahib.translation: Foundation of Nitnem. Lay it with Japji Sahib. Come, let's do paath.

japji_sahib.title: 🤍 Sach khand da raasta
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib vich likheya hai. Paath da vela aa gaya. 🌸
japji_sahib.translation: The path to Sach Khand. Is written in Japji Sahib. Time for paath has come.

japji_sahib.title: 📖 Har pal ik navi seekh
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib vichon milde hai. Paath karan da sama hai. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Every moment a new lesson. Comes from Japji Sahib. It's time for paath.

japji_sahib.title: 🌸 Mann da bojh utariye
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath naal. Vela aa gaya hai. 🪷
japji_sahib.translation: Remove the burden of the mind. With Japji Sahib paath. The time has come.

japji_sahib.title: ✨ Guru Ji de bachan
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib vich sunan da vela hai. Aao baithiye. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Guru Ji's words. Time to listen in Japji Sahib. Come, sit.

japji_sahib.title: 🌺 Amrit ghol
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath hai. Pijiye te mann nu shanti do. 🌸
japji_sahib.translation: Nectar drink. Japji Sahib paath is. Drink it and give peace to your mind.

japji_sahib.title: 🪷 Panch khande to baad
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath karna na bhulo. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: After the five khands. Don't forget to read Japji Sahib. Time has come.

japji_sahib.title: 🤍 Subah di pehli roshanai
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib de shabd ne. Aao paath kariye. 🌸
japji_sahib.translation: Morning's first light. Is Japji Sahib's words. Come, let's read.

japji_sahib.title: 🌸 Jithe jaiye, Guru naal
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath karan baad eh ahsaas hunda hai. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Wherever you go, with Guru. This feeling comes after Japji Sahib paath.

japji_sahib.title: 📖 Nitnem da mukh
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib hai. Aao paath karan da vela aa gaya. 🌺
japji_sahib.translation: The face of Nitnem. Is Japji Sahib. Come, time for paath has arrived.

japji_sahib.title: ✨ Mann ho shant, ruh ho khush
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath naal. Vela shuru ho gaya. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Mind be calm, soul be happy. With Japji Sahib paath. Time has begun.

japji_sahib.title: 🪷 Satguru da prasad
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib hai. Laiyo, paath karan da vela aa gaya. 🌸
japji_sahib.translation: Satguru's blessing. Is Japji Sahib. Take it, time for paath has come.

japji_sahib.title: 🌺 Parmatma de darshan
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath vich hunde ne. Aao baithiye. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Vision of the Divine. Happens in Japji Sahib paath. Come, sit.

japji_sahib.title: 🤍 Jiwan di map
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib vich hai. Paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🌸
japji_sahib.translation: Life's measure. Is in Japji Sahib. Time for paath has arrived.

japji_sahib.title: 🌸 Parche asankh, bakhshishan asankh
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib da vela hai. Aao Guru Sahib naal jutiye. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: Countless chapters, countless blessings. It's Japji Sahib time. Come connect with Guru Sahib.

japji_sahib.title: 📖 Sabse pyari bani
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath da vela aa gaya hai. Aao shanti pao. 🪷
japji_sahib.translation: The most beloved bani. Time for Japji Sahib paath has come. Come find peace.

japji_sahib.title: ✨ Guru Nanak Patshah Ji de mukh ton
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib sunne da vela hai. Paath kariye. 🙏
japji_sahib.translation: From Guru Nanak Patshah Ji's mouth. Time to hear Japji Sahib. Do paath.

japji_sahib.title: 🌺 Mann da rasta saaf kariye
japji_sahib.body: Japji Sahib paath naal. Vela aa gaya hai. 🌸
japji_sahib.translation: Clear the mind's path. With Japji Sahib paath. Time has come.

jaap_sahib.title: ⚔️ Waheguru Ji...
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath da vela hai. Akal Purakh di mahima gao. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Waheguru Ji... Time for Jaap Sahib. Sing the glory of Akal Purakh.

jaap_sahib.title: ✨ 199 bandna, 199 roop
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib da vela hai. Guru Gobind Singh Ji naal jude. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: 199 salutations, 199 forms. It's Jaap Sahib time. Connect with Guru Gobind Singh Ji.

jaap_sahib.title: 🪷 Nirankar di mahima
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib vich hai. Paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: The glory of the Formless. Is in Jaap Sahib. Time for paath has arrived.

jaap_sahib.title: 🌺 Dashmesh Pita Ji di rachna
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath da vela hai. Aao mann lagao. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: Tenth Master's creation. It's Jaap Sahib paath time. Come focus your mind.

jaap_sahib.title: 🤍 Shakti te shanti dono
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath vich mildi hai. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Both strength and peace. Come in Jaap Sahib paath. Time has arrived.

jaap_sahib.title: ✨ Khadag Kete Maha...
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib di shuruaat da vela hai. Aao paath kariye. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: Khadag Kete Maha... Time to begin Jaap Sahib. Come, let's do paath.

jaap_sahib.title: 🌸 Mann vich bahaduri, dil vich pyar
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath naal dono mildi hai. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Courage in mind, love in heart. Both come with Jaap Sahib paath. Time has come.

jaap_sahib.title: 🪷 Akal Purakh de anant naam
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib vich hain. Paath da sama hai. 🌺
jaap_sahib.translation: Akal Purakh's infinite names. Are in Jaap Sahib. It's time for paath.

jaap_sahib.title: ✨ Roop anoot, gun asankh
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath karo te mehsoos karo. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Unique form, countless virtues. Do Jaap Sahib paath and feel it.

jaap_sahib.title: 🤍 Guru Gobind Singh Ji di awaaz
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib vich suno. Paath da vela aa gaya. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: Guru Gobind Singh Ji's voice. Listen in Jaap Sahib. Time for paath has come.

jaap_sahib.title: 🌺 Dar mitao, hausla vadao
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath naal. Aao shuru kariye. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Remove fear, increase courage. With Jaap Sahib paath. Come, let's begin.

jaap_sahib.title: 🌸 Asa anant, man anant
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath da vela hai. Mann lagao. 🪷
jaap_sahib.translation: Infinite hope, infinite mind. It's Jaap Sahib paath time. Focus.

jaap_sahib.title: ✨ Nirankar, niranjan, nirmaan
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib vich hain sabh naam. Paath kariye. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Formless, spotless, prideless. All names are in Jaap Sahib. Do paath.

jaap_sahib.title: 🤍 Nitnew da duja hira
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib hai. Aao paath karan da vela aa gaya. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: Nitnem's second diamond. Is Jaap Sahib. Come, time for paath has arrived.

jaap_sahib.title: 🪷 Har awaaz vich Waheguru
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath karke dekho. Vela shuru ho gaya. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Waheguru in every voice. Do Jaap Sahib paath and see. Time has begun.

jaap_sahib.title: 🌺 Srisht da malik
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib vich bandeya hai. Paath da sama aa gaya. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: Lord of creation. Is praised in Jaap Sahib. Time for paath has come.

jaap_sahib.title: ✨ Khalsa da zor
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath hai. Aao shakti prapt kariye. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: The Khalsa's strength. Is Jaap Sahib paath. Come receive power.

jaap_sahib.title: 🌸 Rog kate, sog kate
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath naal. Vela aa gaya hai. 🪷
jaap_sahib.translation: Remove disease, remove sorrow. With Jaap Sahib paath. Time has come.

jaap_sahib.title: 🤍 Dashmesh Pita Ji di meharbani
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath vich hai. Aao laiyo. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Tenth Master's blessing. Is in Jaap Sahib paath. Come receive it.

jaap_sahib.title: 🌺 Parmatma de gun gao
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib naal. Paath da vela aa gaya. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: Sing God's virtues. With Jaap Sahib. Time for paath has arrived.

jaap_sahib.title: ✨ Mann nirvair, mann nirankaar
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath naal banao. Vela hai. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Mind without enmity, mind formless. Make it with Jaap Sahib paath. It's time.

jaap_sahib.title: 🪷 Bir ras, shanti ras
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib vich dono ne. Paath karo. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: Essence of courage, essence of peace. Both are in Jaap Sahib. Do paath.

jaap_sahib.title: 🌸 Anant shakti da srot
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib hai. Aao paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Source of infinite power. Is Jaap Sahib. Come, time for paath has arrived.

jaap_sahib.title: 🤍 Waheguru de roop
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib vich dekho. Paath da vela hai. 🌺
jaap_sahib.translation: Forms of Waheguru. See in Jaap Sahib. It's paath time.

jaap_sahib.title: ✨ Guru Ji de hathan likhi
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib paath karo. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
jaap_sahib.translation: Written by Guru Ji's hands. Do Jaap Sahib paath. Time has come.

jaap_sahib.title: 🪷 Jit baar parhiye, navi taqat
jaap_sahib.body: Jaap Sahib har baar navi hai. Paath kariye. 🌸
jaap_sahib.translation: Each time you read, new strength. Jaap Sahib is new each time. Do paath.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🌸 Waheguru Ji...
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath da vela hai. Khalsa di mahima suno. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Waheguru Ji... Time for Tav Prasad Swaye. Listen to the glory of Khalsa.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: ✨ Khalsa di pehchan
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye vich hai. Paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🌺
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: The identity of Khalsa. Is in Tav Prasad Swaye. Time for paath has arrived.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🪷 Sant sipahi da darja
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath vich mildi hai. Vela hai. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: The rank of saint-soldier. Comes in Tav Prasad Swaye paath. It's time.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🌺 Dashmesh Pita Ji da updesh
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath da vela aa gaya. Aao suno. 🌸
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Tenth Master's teaching. Time for Tav Prasad Swaye paath has come. Come listen.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🤍 Pyar te tyag, dono saath
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye vich sikhaya hai. Paath kariye. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Love and sacrifice, both together. Taught in Tav Prasad Swaye. Do paath.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: ✨ Mitthe bol, kathor iraade
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath da vela hai. Mann lagao. 🌸
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Sweet words, strong resolve. It's Tav Prasad Swaye paath time. Focus your mind.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🌸 Khalsa di shaan
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye vich hai. Paath da sama aa gaya. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: The pride of Khalsa. Is in Tav Prasad Swaye. Time for paath has arrived.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🪷 Guru Ji di kirpa naal
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath karo. Vela aa gaya. 🌺
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: With Guru Ji's grace. Do Tav Prasad Swaye paath. Time has come.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🌺 Nimrata te nidar
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye vich hai raasta. Paath kariye. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Humility and fearlessness. The path is in Tav Prasad Swaye. Do paath.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: ✨ Khalsa ki sikhya
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath da vela hai. Aao suno. 🌸
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: The teaching of Khalsa. It's Tav Prasad Swaye paath time. Come listen.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🤍 Guru Gobind Singh Ji di awaaz
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye vich goonjdi hai. Paath karo. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Guru Gobind Singh Ji's voice. Echoes in Tav Prasad Swaye. Do paath.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🌸 Sat te nyaa da sang
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath vich hai. Vela aa gaya. 🪷
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Union of truth and justice. Is in Tav Prasad Swaye paath. Time has come.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🪷 Akal Purakh di mehar
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath naal mildi hai. Aao kariye. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Akal Purakh's blessings. Come with Tav Prasad Swaye paath. Come do it.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🌺 Chotta paath, vade arth
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye hai. Paath da sama aa gaya. 🌸
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Short paath, deep meanings. Is Tav Prasad Swaye. Time for paath has arrived.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: ✨ Khalsa bano, Khalsa banaao
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath vich sikh. Vela hai. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Become Khalsa, create Khalsa. Learn in Tav Prasad Swaye paath. It's time.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🤍 Guru ki fauj da jazba
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye vich hai. Paath kariye. 🌺
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: The spirit of Guru's army. Is in Tav Prasad Swaye. Do paath.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🌸 Sarb kala da malik
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath da vela aa gaya. Aao shuru kariye. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Master of all powers. Time for Tav Prasad Swaye paath has come. Come, let's begin.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🪷 Mann vich sakoon, tan vich shakti
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath naal. Vela hai. 🌸
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Peace in mind, power in body. With Tav Prasad Swaye paath. It's time.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: 🌺 Guru Ji da aashirwad
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath vich prapat karo. Sama aa gaya. 🙏
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Guru Ji's blessing. Receive in Tav Prasad Swaye paath. Time has arrived.

tav_prasad_swaye.title: ✨ Khalsa ji ka bol bala
tav_prasad_swaye.body: Tav Prasad Swaye paath da vela hai. Aao kariye. 🌸
tav_prasad_swaye.translation: Victory to the Khalsa. It's Tav Prasad Swaye paath time. Come do it.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🛡️ Waheguru Ji...
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath da vela hai. Raksha da dhaal lao. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: Waheguru Ji... Time for Chaupai Sahib. Take the shield of protection.

chaupai_sahib.title: ✨ Har taraf Guru Ji di chhaaya
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath naal mehsoos karo. Vela aa gaya. 🌸
chaupai_sahib.translation: Guru Ji's shelter everywhere. Feel it with Chaupai Sahib paath. Time has come.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🪷 Dar khatam, shanti hazir
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath da sama hai. Aao kariye. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: Fear gone, peace present. It's Chaupai Sahib paath time. Come do it.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🌺 Guru Ji rakhan vaale
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib vich bandiye. Paath karan da vela hai. 🌸
chaupai_sahib.translation: Guru Ji the protector. Is praised in Chaupai Sahib. It's paath time.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🤍 Mann vich koi dar nahi
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath karan baad. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: No fear in mind. After Chaupai Sahib paath. Time has come.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🌸 Raksha kavach
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib hai. Paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🪷
chaupai_sahib.translation: Protective armor. Is Chaupai Sahib. Time for paath has arrived.

chaupai_sahib.title: ✨ Sabh takaton nalo vada
chaupai_sahib.body: Guru Ji da naam hai. Chaupai Sahib paath kariye. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: Greater than all powers. Is Guru Ji's name. Do Chaupai Sahib paath.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🌺 Koi bhau nahi, koi shok nahi
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath da vela hai. Mann lagao. 🌸
chaupai_sahib.translation: No fear, no sorrow. It's Chaupai Sahib paath time. Focus your mind.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🪷 Hamri karo haath de raksha
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib vich ardaas hai. Paath karo. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: Protect us with Your hands. Prayer is in Chaupai Sahib. Do paath.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🤍 Guru Ji da haath sir te
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath naal mehsoos hunda. Vela hai. 🌸
chaupai_sahib.translation: Guru Ji's hand on your head. Feels it with Chaupai Sahib paath. It's time.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🌸 Dukh bhanjan tera naam
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath da vela aa gaya. Aao kariye. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: Destroyer of pain is Your name. Time for Chaupai Sahib paath has come. Come do it.

chaupai_sahib.title: ✨ Sabh gobind hai, sabh gobind hai
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath vich yaad aunda. Sama hai. 🌺
chaupai_sahib.translation: All is Gobind, all is Gobind. Remembered in Chaupai Sahib paath. It's time.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🌺 Guru Gobind Singh Ji di bani
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath karo. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: Guru Gobind Singh Ji's word. Do Chaupai Sahib paath. Time has come.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🪷 Bhau kahu ko det nahi
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath da vela hai. Aao shanti pao. 🌸
chaupai_sahib.translation: He frightens no one. It's Chaupai Sahib paath time. Come find peace.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🤍 Mann vich vishwaas
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath naal pucca hunda. Paath kariye. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: Faith in mind. Becomes firm with Chaupai Sahib paath. Do paath.

chaupai_sahib.title: ✨ Rakshak te data
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib vich bandeya. Paath da sama hai. 🌺
chaupai_sahib.translation: Protector and giver. Praised in Chaupai Sahib. It's paath time.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🌸 Apne das ki aap raksha
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath vich ardaas. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: You Yourself protect Your servant. Prayer in Chaupai Sahib paath. Time has come.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🪷 Guru Ji da hath pakadiye
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath naal. Aao kariye. 🌸
chaupai_sahib.translation: Hold Guru Ji's hand. With Chaupai Sahib paath. Come do it.

chaupai_sahib.title: 🌺 Prabh hamesha naal hai
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath karan baad eh yakin. Vela hai. 🙏
chaupai_sahib.translation: God is always with you. This certainty after Chaupai Sahib paath. It's time.

chaupai_sahib.title: ✨ Sahib da sahaara
chaupai_sahib.body: Chaupai Sahib paath hai. Paath da vela aa gaya. 🌸
chaupai_sahib.translation: Master's support. Is Chaupai Sahib paath. Time for paath has arrived.

anand_sahib.title: 🌸 Waheguru Ji...
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath da vela hai. Mann vich anand bharo. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Waheguru Ji... Time for Anand Sahib. Fill your mind with bliss.

anand_sahib.title: ✨ Anand bhaya meri maaye
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🌺
anand_sahib.translation: I am in bliss, O my mother. Time for Anand Sahib paath has arrived.

anand_sahib.title: 🪷 Guru Amar Das Ji di bani
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath da vela hai. Aao khushi pao. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Guru Amar Das Ji's word. It's Anand Sahib paath time. Come find joy.

anand_sahib.title: 🌺 Satguru mileya meri maaye
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib vich gao. Paath da vela aa gaya. 🌸
anand_sahib.translation: I have met the True Guru, O my mother. Sing in Anand Sahib. Time for paath has come.

anand_sahib.title: 🤍 Khushi da srot
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath hai. Aao kariye. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Source of happiness. Is Anand Sahib paath. Come do it.

anand_sahib.title: 🌸 Mann vich anand
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath naal aunda. Vela hai. 🪷
anand_sahib.translation: Bliss in mind. Comes with Anand Sahib paath. It's time.

anand_sahib.title: ✨ 40 paurian khushian di
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath da sama aa gaya. Aao kariye. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: 40 stanzas of happiness. Time for Anand Sahib paath has arrived. Come do it.

anand_sahib.title: 🌺 Nitnem da ant pyara
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib naal. Paath karan da vela aa gaya. 🌸
anand_sahib.translation: Nitnem's sweet ending. With Anand Sahib. Time for paath has arrived.

anand_sahib.title: 🪷 Ruh vich sukoon
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath naal mildi hai. Vela hai. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Peace in the soul. Comes with Anand Sahib paath. It's time.

anand_sahib.title: 🤍 Guru Ji di khushi
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath vich mehsoos karo. Sama hai. 🌸
anand_sahib.translation: Guru Ji's joy. Feel it in Anand Sahib paath. It's time.

anand_sahib.title: 🌸 Dukh mite, sukh aaye
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath naal. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Pain removed, happiness comes. With Anand Sahib paath. Time has come.

anand_sahib.title: ✨ Sacha mool
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath vich hai. Aao padhiye. 🌺
anand_sahib.translation: The true root. Is in Anand Sahib paath. Come read.

anand_sahib.title: 🌺 Mann maneya, tan thanda
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath naal. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Mind content, body cool. With Anand Sahib paath. Time has come.

anand_sahib.title: 🪷 Guru Sahib ka prasad
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath hai. Paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🌸
anand_sahib.translation: Guru Sahib's blessing. Is Anand Sahib paath. Time for paath has arrived.

anand_sahib.title: 🤍 Sachkhand vich jana hai?
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath raasta hai. Aao kariye. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Want to reach Sachkhand? Anand Sahib paath is the path. Come do it.

anand_sahib.title: 🌸 Anand utsav
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath naal manao. Vela hai. 🌺
anand_sahib.translation: Festival of bliss. Celebrate with Anand Sahib paath. It's time.

anand_sahib.title: ✨ Guru Amar Das Patshah Ji
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath vich milange. Paath karo. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Guru Amar Das Patshah Ji. Will meet in Anand Sahib paath. Do paath.

anand_sahib.title: 🌺 Prabh ka sukh anand
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath da vela aa gaya. Mann lagao. 🌸
anand_sahib.translation: God's peace and bliss. Time for Anand Sahib paath has come. Focus your mind.

anand_sahib.title: 🪷 Ruh jagdi hai
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath naal. Aao kariye. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: The soul awakens. With Anand Sahib paath. Come do it.

anand_sahib.title: 🤍 Khushi da asman
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath vich hai. Vela aa gaya. 🌸
anand_sahib.translation: Sky of happiness. Is in Anand Sahib paath. Time has come.

anand_sahib.title: 🌸 Nitnem sampooran karo
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath naal. Sama hai. 🙏
anand_sahib.translation: Complete Nitnem. With Anand Sahib paath. It's time.

anand_sahib.title: ✨ Guru Ji di galgi
anand_sahib.body: Anand Sahib paath vich lao. Paath karo. 🌺
anand_sahib.translation: Guru Ji's embrace. Take in Anand Sahib paath. Do paath.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌅 Waheguru Ji...
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib da vela aa gaya. Guru Maharaj Ji di khushian lavo. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Waheguru Ji... Time for Rehras Sahib has come. Receive Guru Maharaj Ji's blessings.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌸 Suraj dubda ja reha hai
rehras_sahib.body: Par Guru Ji di roshni hamesha hai. Rehras Sahib paath kariye. 🌺
rehras_sahib.translation: The sun is setting. But Guru Ji's light is eternal. Do Rehras Sahib paath.

rehras_sahib.title: ✨ Shaam da sukoon
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal aao. Vela aa gaya. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Evening's peace. Come with Rehras Sahib paath. Time has arrived.

rehras_sahib.title: 🪷 Din khatam hunda vekh rahe ho?
rehras_sahib.body: Guru Maharaj Ji da shukar karo. Rehras Sahib da vela hai. 🌸
rehras_sahib.translation: Watching the day end? Thank Guru Maharaj Ji. It's Rehras Sahib time.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌺 Shaam di ardaas
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath hai. Aao Guru Sahib naal jude. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Evening prayer. Is Rehras Sahib paath. Come connect with Guru Sahib.

rehras_sahib.title: 🤍 Ajj da din Guru Kirpa naal guzreya
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal shukar karo. Vela aa gaya. 🌸
rehras_sahib.translation: Today passed by Guru's grace. Give thanks with Rehras Sahib paath. Time has come.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌅 Shaad di vidayi
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal karo. Sama hai. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Farewell to the day. Do with Rehras Sahib paath. It's time.

rehras_sahib.title: ✨ So dar tera kehda
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath vich gao. Vela aa gaya. 🌸
rehras_sahib.translation: Where is that door of Yours? Sing in Rehras Sahib paath. Time has come.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌺 Thak gaye ho?
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal sukoon pao. Aao kariye. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Are you tired? Find rest with Rehras Sahib paath. Come do it.

rehras_sahib.title: 🪷 Shaam di roshni
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath hai. Paath karan da vela aa gaya. 🌸
rehras_sahib.translation: Evening's light. Is Rehras Sahib paath. Time for paath has arrived.

rehras_sahib.title: 🤍 Guru Ji nu yaad karo
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal. Sama hai. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Remember Guru Ji. With Rehras Sahib paath. It's time.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌸 Din di khasusi karo
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath vich. Vela aa gaya. 🌺
rehras_sahib.translation: End the day. In Rehras Sahib paath. Time has come.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌅 Rab da shukar ada karo
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal. Aao kariye. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Give thanks to God. With Rehras Sahib paath. Come do it.

rehras_sahib.title: ✨ Shaam ka darbar
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath hai. Paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🌸
rehras_sahib.translation: Evening's court. Is Rehras Sahib paath. Time for paath has arrived.

rehras_sahib.title: 🪷 Andhera aun ton pehle
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal Guru Ji naal judo. Vela hai. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Before darkness comes. Connect with Guru Ji through Rehras Sahib paath. It's time.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌺 Benanti paath
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath da vela aa gaya. Mann lagao. 🌸
rehras_sahib.translation: Prayer of supplication. Time for Rehras Sahib paath has come. Focus your mind.

rehras_sahib.title: 🤍 Guru Ji hamesha saath ne
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal eh yaad aunda. Aao kariye. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Guru Ji is always with you. This is remembered with Rehras Sahib paath. Come do it.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌅 Shaam di mithaas
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath vich hai. Vela aa gaya. 🌺
rehras_sahib.translation: Evening's sweetness. Is in Rehras Sahib paath. Time has come.

rehras_sahib.title: ✨ Panch banian, ik vela
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath da sama hai. Aao baithiye. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Five banis, one time. It's Rehras Sahib paath time. Come sit.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌸 Din da hisaab kitaab
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal Guru Sahib agge karo. Vela hai. 🌸
rehras_sahib.translation: The day's accounting. Do before Guru Sahib with Rehras Sahib paath. It's time.

rehras_sahib.title: 🪷 Sham nu shanti naal
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath karan da vela aa gaya. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Evening with peace. Time for Rehras Sahib paath has arrived.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌺 Guru Maharaj Ji di meharbani
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath vich maango. Sama hai. 🌸
rehras_sahib.translation: Guru Maharaj Ji's mercy. Ask for in Rehras Sahib paath. It's time.

rehras_sahib.title: 🤍 Shaam da sangat
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal Guru de charna vich. Aao kariye. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: Evening's congregation. At Guru's feet with Rehras Sahib paath. Come do it.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌅 Suraj dubiya, par mann jagde raho
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath naal. Vela aa gaya. 🌺
rehras_sahib.translation: Sun has set, but keep your mind awake. With Rehras Sahib paath. Time has come.

rehras_sahib.title: ✨ Guru Ji de darbar vich
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🙏
rehras_sahib.translation: In Guru Ji's court. Time for Rehras Sahib paath has arrived.

rehras_sahib.title: 🌸 Shaam di prarthna
rehras_sahib.body: Rehras Sahib paath hai. Aao mann lagao. 🪷
rehras_sahib.translation: Evening prayer. Is Rehras Sahib paath. Come focus your mind.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌙 Waheguru Ji...
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath da vela hai. Raat nu shanti naal bitao. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Waheguru Ji... Time for Kirtan Sohila. Spend the night with peace.

kirtan_sohila.title: ✨ Neend aun ton pehle
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath karo. Guru Sahib de charna vich souvo. 🌸
kirtan_sohila.translation: Before sleep comes. Do Kirtan Sohila paath. Sleep at Guru Sahib's feet.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🪷 Raat da pahra shuru
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath naal. Vela aa gaya hai. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Night's watch begins. With Kirtan Sohila paath. Time has come.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌺 Guru Ji de hawaale karo ajj nu
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath da vela hai. Aao kariye. 🌸
kirtan_sohila.translation: Surrender today to Guru Ji. It's Kirtan Sohila paath time. Come do it.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🤍 Shant neend da raaz
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath vich hai. Paath karo. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Secret of peaceful sleep. Is in Kirtan Sohila paath. Do paath.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌙 Raat di shuruwaat Guru naal
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath karan da sama aa gaya. 🌸
kirtan_sohila.translation: Start the night with Guru. Time for Kirtan Sohila paath has arrived.

kirtan_sohila.title: ✨ Ruh nu araam do
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath naal. Vela hai. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Give rest to your soul. With Kirtan Sohila paath. It's time.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌸 Din da akhiri paath
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila hai. Aao shanti naal khatam kariye. 🌺
kirtan_sohila.translation: Last paath of the day. Is Kirtan Sohila. Come end peacefully.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🪷 Guru Sahib nu goodnight kahiye
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath naal. Sama aa gaya. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Say goodnight to Guru Sahib. With Kirtan Sohila paath. Time has arrived.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌙 Andhera gabhru ho reha hai
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath naal roshni bharo. Vela hai. 🌸
kirtan_sohila.translation: Darkness is deepening. Fill with light through Kirtan Sohila paath. It's time.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🤍 Nitnem da samapan
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath naal karo. Aao kariye. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Conclusion of Nitnem. Do with Kirtan Sohila paath. Come do it.

kirtan_sohila.title: ✨ Raat nu Guru de hawaale
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath da vela aa gaya. 🌺
kirtan_sohila.translation: Surrender the night to Guru. Time for Kirtan Sohila paath has come.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌸 Sukh neend da prasad
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath vich hai. Paath karo. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Gift of peaceful sleep. Is in Kirtan Sohila paath. Do paath.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌙 Raat da Simran
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath hai. Vela aa gaya. 🌸
kirtan_sohila.translation: Night's meditation. Is Kirtan Sohila paath. Time has come.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🪷 Guru Ji de bachan sutt ton pehle
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath karo. Aao kariye. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Guru Ji's words before sleeping. Do Kirtan Sohila paath. Come do it.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌺 Shanti naal so jao
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath baad. Vela aa gaya. 🌸
kirtan_sohila.translation: Sleep with peace. After Kirtan Sohila paath. Time has come.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🤍 Raat da aashirwad
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath vich prapat karo. Sama hai. 🙏
kirtan_sohila.translation: Night's blessing. Receive in Kirtan Sohila paath. It's time.

kirtan_sohila.title: 🌙 Raat bhar Guru rakhe
kirtan_sohila.body: Kirtan Sohila paath karan da vela hai. 🌸
kirtan_sohila.translation: Guru protects all night. It's Kirtan Sohila paath time.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Ajj kujh pal Guru Maharaj Ji nu yaad kariye
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Remember Guru Maharaj Ji for a few moments today. Just one deep breath... Waheguru.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Ik gehra saah
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Waheguru Waheguru... Mann shant ho jaanda hai. ✨
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: One deep breath. Waheguru Waheguru... The mind becomes calm.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌿 Dil shant ho janda hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: The heart becomes peaceful. When we connect with Naam.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ☀️ Ajj da sab ton sona pal
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Today's most golden moment. Is at Guru's feet.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Guru di kirpa hamesha naal hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Guru's grace is always with you. Just need to pay attention.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🪷 Kujh seconds Naam jap lo
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Chant Naam for a few seconds. The whole day can change.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Waheguru hamesha sunnde ne
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Chahe tusi bolo ya na bolo. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Waheguru always listens. Whether you speak or not.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Jithe tusi ho
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Uthe hi Guru Ji hazir ne. ✨
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Wherever you are. Guru Ji is present there.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Mann vich hulchul hai?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Ik pal Waheguru Waheguru jap lo. 🌿
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Is your mind restless? Chant Waheguru Waheguru for a moment.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🕊️ Shanti bahut nazdeek hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Peace is very close. Just one Naam away.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Guru Ji di yaad
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Sabse vadde sukoon da kaaran hai. 🌸
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Remembering Guru Ji. Is the greatest source of peace.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Parmatma door nahi
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: God is not far. He is within your heart.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🪷 Saah lene vich vi Simran
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Even in breathing is Simran. Waheguru comes in, Waheguru goes out.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌿 Koi vada kaam nahi chaheeda
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Sirf Guru nu yaad karna kaafi hai. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: No grand action needed. Just remembering Guru is enough.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Ajj thank you kaho
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Waheguru Ji da. Lakh lakh shukar. ✨
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Say thank you today. To Waheguru Ji. A million thanks.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Ruh piyasi hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Your soul is thirsty. Drink the water of Naam.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Guru Ji hamesha sunni de ne
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Guru Ji always listens. You just start speaking.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Eh pal vi bakhshish hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: This moment is also a blessing. Received by Guru's grace.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌿 Mann nu taaza karo
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Refresh your mind. Waheguru Waheguru... just this much.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🪷 Satguru rakhe naal
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Satguru keeps you with Him. Every moment, every instant.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Thaka mahesoos kar rahe ho?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru de charna vich 2 pal baitho. ✨
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Feeling tired? Sit at Guru's feet for 2 moments.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Jo vi ho reha hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Whatever is happening. Is Guru's grace. Keep faith.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🕊️ Parmatma de bachan sunna chaunde ho?
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Want to hear God's words? Become silent, you'll hear.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Ajj nu khaas banao
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Kujh pal Naam Simran kar ke. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Make today special. By doing Naam Simran for a few moments.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Guru Ji tuhanu pyar karde ne
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Guru Ji loves you. Whether you know it or not.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌿 Waheguru da Naam
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Waheguru's Naam. Is the greatest treasure.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Mann nu pyaas lagi hai?
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Is your mind thirsty? Drink the water of Naam.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Khush rehne ka raaz
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru Maharaj Ji di yaad vich hai. 🌸
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Secret of staying happy. Is in remembering Guru Maharaj Ji.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🪷 Koi gall pareshan kar rahi hai?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru Ji nu dass do. Sunn lenge. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Is something troubling you? Tell Guru Ji. He will listen.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🕊️ Ruh shant ho jandi hai
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Jad Guru de charna vich baithe. 🌸
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: The soul becomes peaceful. When sitting at Guru's feet.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Tuhaada hona ik bakhshish hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Your existence is a blessing. Thanks to Waheguru.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Chinta khatam karna hai?
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Want to end worry? Trust in Waheguru.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Akal Purakh sada naal hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Akal Purakh is always with you. Just learn to feel it.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Bas ik pal ruk jao
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Just stop for one moment. And chant Waheguru Waheguru.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌿 Parmatma di bakhshish
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: God's blessing. Is in every breath.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Pyaar naal yaad karo
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru Maharaj Ji nu. Zaroor milange. 🤍
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Remember with love. Guru Maharaj Ji. You will surely meet Him.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🪷 Khushiyan bhaal rahe ho?
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Looking for happiness? Do Naam Simran. You'll find it.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Guru Ji da hath pakad ke chalo
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Walk holding Guru Ji's hand. The path will become easier.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🕊️ Shanti door nahi
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Peace is not far. Just one Waheguru away.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Ajj Guru Ji nu miss kar rahe ho?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Oh vi tuhaanu miss kar rahe ne. 🌿
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Missing Guru Ji today? He's missing you too.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Mann vich duvidha hai?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru Granth Sahib Ji khol ke dekho. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Doubt in your mind? Open Guru Granth Sahib Ji and see.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Ruh nu jagao
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Naam Simran naal. Aao shuru kariye. 🪷
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Awaken your soul. With Naam Simran. Come, let's begin.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Tusi akele nahi ho
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: You are not alone. Waheguru is always with you.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌿 Ik chhoti jihi smile
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Waheguru nu yaad kar ke. Dil khush ho jayega. 🌸
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: One small smile. Remembering Waheguru. Your heart will be happy.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Guru Ji di meherbani
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Har jagah dikhdi hai. Nazron nu kholo. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Guru Ji's kindness. Is visible everywhere. Open your eyes.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🪷 Mann pura dol reha hai?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Naam da sahara lo. Thehr jayega. 🤍
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Mind swaying completely? Take support of Naam. It will steady.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Ajj pyaar naal jio
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Live with love today. Waheguru is in everyone.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Raah bhul gaye ho?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru Granth Sahib Ji raasta dikhaunge. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Lost your way? Guru Granth Sahib Ji will show the path.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🕊️ Dukh aaye te ghabrao na
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru Ji naal khade ho. Theek ho jayega. 🌿
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: If pain comes, don't panic. Stand with Guru Ji. It will be okay.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Ajj kise nu maaf kar do
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Forgive someone today. Your mind will feel lighter.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Parmatma di raza vich raho
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Stay in God's will. Happiness will always be with you.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Guru Ji bulare ne tuhanu
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Guru Ji is calling you. Spend a few moments with Him.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Zindagi ik tohfa hai
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Life is a gift. From Waheguru. Give thanks.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌿 Chup chap baith ke
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Sit quietly. Just chant Waheguru Waheguru.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🪷 Ajj di khushi nu pakad lo
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Grasp today's happiness. With Guru Ji's remembrance.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Shabad  dil vich vasao
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Let the word dwell in your heart. Of Gurbani. Mind will change.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Pyaar te nafrat vich
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Tusi pyaar choose karo. Waheguru khush honge. 🌺
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Between love and hate. You choose love. Waheguru will be pleased.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Ruh nu shanti chahiye?
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Soul needs peace? Come to Guru's court.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Guru Maharaj Ji da pyaar
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Ehna gehra hai ki samajh nahi aunda. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Guru Maharaj Ji's love. Is so deep it's incomprehensible.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: ✨ Kujh minutes silence vich bitao
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Spend a few minutes in silence. You'll hear Waheguru's voice.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌿 Tension ho rahi hai?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Naam jap lo. Sab theek ho jayega. 🪷
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Feeling tension? Chant Naam. Everything will be okay.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Akal Purakh di meherbani
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Tuhade utte hamesha barsat ho rahi hai. 🤍
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Akal Purakh's kindness. Is always raining upon you.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🕊️ Mann vich hulchul band karo
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Stop the restlessness in your mind. Call Waheguru. He'll come.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🪷 Guru Ji di galgi vich aao
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Come into Guru Ji's embrace. You'll find great peace.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌺 Darr nahi, pyaar hai
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru Maharaj Ji naal. Hamesha yaad rakho. ✨
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Not fear, but love. With Guru Maharaj Ji. Always remember.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🤍 Ajj kujh acha karo
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Kise de liye. Waheguru khush honge. 🙏
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Do something good today. For someone. Waheguru will be pleased.

random_spiritual_reminders.title: 🌸 Raah mushkil lagdi hai?
random_spiritual_reminders.body: Guru Ji hath pakad ke turde ne. 🌿
random_spiritual_reminders.translation: Path seems difficult? Guru Ji walks holding your hand.

hukamnama.title: 📖 Waheguru Ji...
hukamnama.body: Ajj da Hukamnama Sahib hazir hai. Guru Maharaj Ji da Hukam suno. 🙏
hukamnama.translation: Waheguru Ji... Today's Hukamnama Sahib is here. Listen to Guru Maharaj Ji's command.

hukamnama.title: 🌸 Guru Maharaj Ji da sandesh
hukamnama.body: Ajj de liye aa gaya hai. Hukamnama Sahib padho. 🌺
hukamnama.translation: Guru Maharaj Ji's message. Has arrived for today. Read the Hukamnama Sahib.

hukamnama.title: ✨ Ajj da divine hukam
hukamnama.body: Tayar hai. Aao Guru Sahib di awaaz suno. 🙏
hukamnama.translation: Today's divine command. Is ready. Come listen to Guru Sahib's voice.

hukamnama.title: 🪷 Darbar Sahib ton aaya hukam
hukamnama.body: Ajj de liye. Hukamnama Sahib suno. 🌸
hukamnama.translation: Command has come from Darbar Sahib. For today. Listen to Hukamnama Sahib.

hukamnama.title: 🌺 Guru Ji ki bol rahe ne ajj?
hukamnama.translation: What is Guru Ji saying today? See in Hukamnama Sahib.

hukamnama.title: 🤍 Ajj di rehnumai
hukamnama.body: Hukamnama Sahib vich hai. Aao padho. 🌸
hukamnama.translation: Today's guidance. Is in Hukamnama Sahib. Come read.

hukamnama.title: 📖 Guru Granth Sahib Ji da hukam
hukamnama.body: Ajj de liye tayar hai. Suno te mano. 🙏
hukamnama.translation: Guru Granth Sahib Ji's command. Is ready for today. Listen and obey.

hukamnama.title: ✨ Shabad Guru da updesh
hukamnama.translation: Shabad Guru's teaching. Is in Hukamnama Sahib. Read it.

hukamnama.title: 🌸 Ajj tuhade liye khaas sandesh
hukamnama.translation: Today's special message for you. Is in Hukamnama Sahib.

hukamnama.title: 🪷 Guru Ji ton direct message
hukamnama.body: Hukamnama Sahib hazir hai. Aao suno. 🌸
hukamnama.translation: Direct message from Guru Ji. Hukamnama Sahib is here. Come listen.

simran.title: 🪷 Waheguru Ji...
simran.body: Sirf 5 minute... Waheguru Waheguru jap ke mann nu shanti bakhshiye. 🙏
simran.translation: Waheguru Ji... Just 5 minutes... Chant Waheguru Waheguru and give peace to your mind.

simran.title: ✨ Kujh pal apne liye
simran.body: Naam Simran karo. Ruh taazi ho jayegi. 🌸
simran.translation: A few moments for yourself. Do Naam Simran. Your soul will be refreshed.

simran.title: 🌸 Mann bhatkda ja reha hai?
simran.translation: Mind wandering away? Do 5 minutes Simran. It will steady.

simran.title: 🤍 Waheguru Waheguru...
simran.body: Bas itna hi. 5 minute liye. Mann badal jayega. 🪷
simran.translation: Waheguru Waheguru... Just this much. For 5 minutes. Mind will change.

simran.title: 🌺 Thora samay nikalo
simran.body: Naam Simran waste. Bahut sukoon milega. 🌸
simran.translation: Take out some time. For Naam Simran. Much peace will come.

simran.title: 🪷 Dil vich sukoon chahiye?
simran.body: Naam Simran shuru karo. Hamesha milega. 🙏
simran.translation: Want peace in your heart? Start Naam Simran. You'll always find it.

simran.title: ✨ Busy din hai?
simran.body: 5 minute Simran te kaafi hai. Aao kariye. 🌸
simran.translation: Busy day? 5 minutes Simran is enough. Come do it.

simran.title: 🌿 Ruh nu energy chahiye?
simran.translation: Soul needs energy? Do Naam Simran. You'll get strength.

simran.title: 🌸 Ajj 5 minute Guru de naal
simran.translation: Today spend 5 minutes with Guru. By doing Simran.

simran.title: 🌺 Mann ko chain do
simran.body: Naam Simran naal. Kujh minute hi kaafi ne. 🙏
simran.translation: Give rest to your mind. With Naam Simran. Just a few minutes are enough.

nitnem_missed.title: 🤍 Je ajj sama na mil sakya
nitnem_missed.body: Guru Maharaj Ji de charna vich kujh pal baithna vi bakhshish hai. 🌸
nitnem_missed.translation: If you couldn't find time today. Even sitting at Guru Maharaj Ji's feet for a few moments is a blessing.

nitnem_missed.title: 🌿 Nitnem reh gaya?
nitnem_missed.body: Koi gal nahi. Kujh pal Naam jap lo. Guru Ji samajhde ne. 🙏
nitnem_missed.translation: Nitnem got left behind? It's okay. Chant Naam for a few moments. Guru Ji understands.

nitnem_missed.title: ✨ Kal da nava din aayega
nitnem_missed.body: Ajj je Nitnem na ho sakya, koi gal nahi. Guru Ji hamesha naal ne. 🌸
nitnem_missed.translation: Tomorrow is a new day. If Nitnem couldn't happen today, it's okay. Guru Ji is always with you.

nitnem_missed.title: 🪷 Paath nu bojh na samjho
nitnem_missed.body: Jinna ho sakya utna hi kaafi hai. Guru Ji khush ne. 🤍
nitnem_missed.translation: Don't consider paath a burden. Whatever you could do is enough. Guru Ji is pleased.

bedtime.title: 🌙 Waheguru Ji...
bedtime.body: Ajj da din Guru Kirpa naal guzreya. Shanti naal soyo. 🙏
bedtime.translation: Waheguru Ji... Today passed by Guru's grace. Sleep peacefully.

bedtime.title: ✨ Raat nu Guru de hawaale karo
bedtime.translation: Surrender the night to Guru. Sleep will come peacefully. Good night.

bedtime.title: 🤍 Ajj nu thank you kaho
bedtime.body: Waheguru da. Shanti naal aaraam karo. 🌙
bedtime.translation: Say thank you for today. To Waheguru. Rest peacefully.

bedtime.title: 🌺 Guru Ji tuhanu rakhe
bedtime.translation: Guru Ji keeps you. All night. May you have peaceful sleep.

bedtime.title: 🕊️ Aaraam karo
bedtime.body: Guru Ji de pyaar vich. Kal fir milange. 🌸
bedtime.translation: Rest. In Guru Ji's love. We'll meet again tomorrow.

evening_peace.title: 🌅 Din khatam hunda ja reha hai
evening_peace.body: Kujh pal shanti naal bitao. Guru Ji nu yaad karo. 🙏
evening_peace.translation: The day is ending. Spend a few moments peacefully. Remember Guru Ji.

evening_peace.title: ✨ Shaam da sukoon
evening_peace.body: Naam Simran vich hai. Kujh pal layo. 🌸
evening_peace.translation: Evening's peace. Is in Naam Simran. Take a few moments.

evening_peace.title: 🤍 Ajj kinna acha din guzreya
evening_peace.translation: What a good day passed. Thanks to Waheguru.

gurbani_radio.title: 🎧 Hazoori Kirtan live chal reha hai
gurbani_radio.translation: Hazoori Kirtan is live. Come connect with Guru's house.

gurbani_radio.title: 📻 Gurbani Kirtan shuru ho gaya
gurbani_radio.body: Aao suno te mann shant karo. 🙏
gurbani_radio.translation: Gurbani Kirtan has started. Come listen and calm your mind.
